at_a_glance.headline: Divestiture Reshapes Continuing Financial Profiles
at_a_glance.detail: The company completed the sale of its Regulatory and Medical Writing business, which contributed $19.2 million in discontinued operations revenue through its closing on May 8, 2026.

at_a_glance.headline: Restructuring Targets Future Cost Savings
at_a_glance.detail: Management implemented a 5% reduction in the global workforce, aiming to generate approximately $13 million in run-rate savings to support margin expansion.

at_a_glance.headline: Share Repurchase Program Extended Further
at_a_glance.detail: Following the completion of a $100 million buyback, the board authorized an additional $50 million share repurchase program to reinforce capital allocation flexibility.

BDX.summary: BD reported strong Q3 2026 results with $5 billion in revenue, up 4.4% on an FX-neutral basis. Driven by broad-based commercial momentum, double-digit growth platforms like biologic drug delivery, advanced patient monitoring, PureWick, and advanced tissue regeneration outpaced the overall portfolio. Adjusted operating margin reached 24.9% and adjusted EPS grew 4.9% to $3.23, surpassing expectations.

key_moments.title: Raised Full-Year Guidance
key_moments.blurb: Investors will be pleased that strong Q3 execution and underlying momentum allowed BD to raise the midpoint of its full-year adjusted EPS guidance and target the high end of its revenue range, boosting confidence in the post-separation profile.

key_moments.title: GLP-1 Commercial Traction
key_moments.blurb: Management highlighted robust demand in its BioPharma growth platform, securing approximately 100 agreements across novel and biosimilar GLP-1 programs, demonstrating its capability to capture significant share in a high-growth market.

key_moments.title: Fiscal 2027 Headwinds Defined
key_moments.blurb: While core growth platforms are performing well, investors may be cautious about the fiscal 2027 framework. The conclusion of Alaris remediation will create a 200 basis point revenue headwind next year, limiting near-term top-line expansion.

key_moments.title: Q4 Sequential Slowdown Expected
key_moments.blurb: Management clarified that sequential deceleration in Q4 implied by the updated guidance is not structural. Instead, it reflects a tough prior-year Alaris capital comparison that will impose a 200 basis point headwind in the final quarter.

at_a_glance.headline: BD Tops Estimates by the Numbers
at_a_glance.detail: Becton, Dickinson and Company reported an adjusted EPS of $1.37 and revenue of $4.983 billion for Q3 2026, surpassing the estimated adjusted EPS of 3.138 and estimated revenue of $4.889 billion.

at_a_glance.headline: Strong Growth Across Core Segments
at_a_glance.detail: The company demonstrated broad-based momentum with constant currency revenue growth driven by its Interventional segment at 5.5%, BioPharma Systems at 5.2%, and Connected Care at 4.4%.

at_a_glance.headline: Guidance Raised Following Strong Execution
at_a_glance.detail: Management tightened and raised the midpoint of its full-year fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $12.62 to $12.72 while pushing revenue expectations toward the high end of its low-single-digit range.

at_a_glance.headline: First Full Quarter as New BD
at_a_glance.detail: This reporting period marked the company's first full quarter operating under the streamlined "New BD" corporate structure following the strategic spin-off of its Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business.

at_a_glance.headline: Tariff Headwinds Compress Operational Margins
at_a_glance.detail: Adjusted operating margin fell 130 basis points to 24.9% due to an approximate 110 basis point negative impact from tariffs alongside higher commercial and R&D investments.

at_a_glance.headline: Significant Free Cash Flow Expansion
at_a_glance.detail: Year-to-date free cash flow surged by 44.6% to reach $1.7 billion, driven by working capital improvements and declining Alaris remediation spending.
